Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.loggeddigitalinput

Class LoggedDigitalInput

java.lang.Object
frc.lib.NinjasLib.loggeddigitalinput.LoggedDigitalInput
public class LoggedDigitalInput extends Object
Wraps a LoggedDigitalInputIO (e.g. a limit switch or beam break, real or simulated) to add AdvantageKit logging and an enable/disable fallback. When disabled, the digital input's hardware is never touched and get() always returns a fixed disabledValue instead â€” useful for optional sensors that may not be wired on a given robot. Call periodic() once per loop to refresh and log the current state.

  • Constructor Details

    • LoggedDigitalInput

      public LoggedDigitalInput(String name, int port, boolean enabled, boolean disabledValue, boolean inverted, LoggedDigitalInputIO io)
      Creates a logged digital input. If enabled is true, io is immediately configured via LoggedDigitalInputIO.setup(int, boolean); otherwise io is never used and get() always returns disabledValue.
      Parameters:
      name - the AdvantageKit log key this input's state is logged under
      port - the digital I/O port the input is wired to, passed through to io
      enabled - whether this input is physically present and should be polled
      disabledValue - the value get() returns when enabled is false
      inverted - whether the raw hardware reading should be inverted, passed through to io
      io - the hardware-specific IO implementation (e.g. LoggedDigitalInputIOReal or LoggedDigitalInputIOSim) to poll each cycle

  • Method Details

    • get

      public boolean get()
      Returns:
      the last-read state of the input if enabled, or the constructor-supplied disabledValue if this input is disabled

    • periodic

      public void periodic()
      If enabled, polls the underlying LoggedDigitalInputIO and logs the result to AdvantageKit under this input's name. Must be called once per robot loop for get() to reflect the current hardware state; a no-op when this input is disabled.
